Sandbox_FTZCarts_WorldSpawnChance: Carts on the floor: chance per room (%)
Sandbox_FTZCarts_WorldSpawnChance_toolti: Chance for a supermarket or warehouse room to have carts standing on the floor, rolled once per room. 0 = never.
Sandbox_FTZCarts_WorldSpawnMax: Carts on the floor: maximum per room
Sandbox_FTZCarts_WorldSpawnMax_tooltip: Maximum number of carts standing in the same room (the actual number is rolled between 1 and this maximum).
Sandbox_FTZCarts_LootRate_tooltip: How often carts show up as container loot (hardware stores, Gigamart, tool crates...). 100 = like the original mod, 0 = never, 500 = five times more.
Sandbox_FTZCarts_CartCapacity_tooltip: Weight a shopping cart can hold (37 by default).
Sandbox_FTZCarts_TrolleyCapacity_tooltip: Weight a warehouse platform trolley can hold (50 by default).
